sharpe_definition: mean / sd (ddof 1) of daily returns of the marked-to-market equity on every calendar day of the period (closures forward-filled), x sqrt(365); NaN when ruined
monitor: score = 0.5 * (TRAIN loss + INNER_A loss), both in inference mode at the same checkpoint, same weighting.
